bet_gate: BET enabled only if the dev-selected rule had a positive lower 90% ROI bound and positive CLV on dev, AND on holdout its plays show positive mean CLV and positive ROI. Tightened before the holdout was scored (commit ab83459): the dev rule must also beat the 95th percentile of the same threshold search run on 500 coin-flip worlds (a reality check against threshold mining)
champion: V1 (V2 is eligible; the switch is a person setting the flag)

G1_mae.rule: holdout spread MAE: V2 < V1 and the paired bootstrap 95% CI of (V2 - V1) is entirely below 0

G3_brier.rule: holdout win-probability Brier (shipped calibration): V2 < V1

G6_stability.rule: V2 MAE <= V1 MAE in EVERY holdout season and in >= 6 of 8 dev seasons

G7_subgroups.rule: no holdout subgroup (week, P4/G5, spread size; n >= 100) where V2 MAE exceeds V1 by > 0.75

note: A pass makes V2 eligible. Production switches only when a person sets the flag.
